verdict.rationale: LangGraph is itself a Python (and JS) SDK for building agentic graphs, with pip-installable packages, extensive official docs covering state, persistence, streaming, interrupts, and multi-agent patterns, plus a CLI for local dev/deployment. Community evidence corroborates real hands-on SDK usage (custom nodes, tool handling) rather than just marketing claims. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of SDK stability/versioning across languages, and no explicit mention of official SDKs beyond Python/JS (e.g., other language bindings).
